system.description: You compress and release built up stellar energy into bursts of power. When you take the Attack action and make a Stellar Knuckle or Plasma Burst attack or cast a Keton Hijutsu that deals damage, you can spend 1 Stellar Charge to magnify their power. Increase the damage you deal with them by +2, until the end of the current turn. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.
